title: My Math Test
source_body:
Thursday, November 13

Today we had a math test. It was about fractions. Last night, I studied for two hours, but I was still nervous in the morning.

There were twenty questions on the test. The first ten questions were easy. But questions 15 and 18 were very difficult. I solved them slowly and checked all my answers two times.

After lunch, Ms. Kang gave back our tests. I got 90 points! Last month, I got 75 points, so my score was 15 points higher. My mom was very happy, and she made pizza for dinner.

Next time, I will practice more word problems. I want to get 100 points.

variants.prestudy:
Thursday, November 13

Today our class took a math test on fractions. Although I studied for two hours the night before, I was still extremely nervous when I arrived at school in the morning.

The test consisted of twenty questions. The first ten were simple enough for me to answer quickly, but questions 15 and 18 were especially challenging. I worked through them slowly and carefully, and then I reviewed all of my answers twice to avoid careless mistakes.

After lunch, Ms. Kang returned our graded tests, and I found out that I received 90 points! Since I scored only 75 points last month, my score improved by 15 points. My mom was so proud of me that she made pizza for dinner to celebrate.

From now on, I am going to practice more word problems, because my goal is to earn a perfect score of 100 points next time.
